$comment: Our schema of an Azure Pipelines file, the shape Azure DevOps reads, kept local so an editor and a gate need no download.
description: Our schema of an Azure Pipelines file, an inner contract (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): the shape Azure DevOps reads, kept local so an editor and a gate need no download. source: https://github.com/microsoft/azure-pipelines-vscode service-schema.json (the full schema models a step's task as one anyOf branch per known task version, which offline reports every branch that does not match), trimmed to the top-level shape, the container types, and one loose step whose task is Name@Major or a template expression. Every pipeline file is bound to it by contract.yml's applies_to. Taken 2026-10-25.
